summary.plain: The fifth detector approved for DESY's PETRA collider, installed in 1980 to replace PLUTO. It recorded e+e- collisions until PETRA closed in 1986 and its detector paper describes it as a new detector for PETRA.
summary.technical: CELLO: one of the five PETRA proposals recommended in October 1976; newly built detector installed in March 1980 to replace PLUTO at its collision region; described in 'Cello - A New Detector at PETRA' (Physica Scripta 23 (1981) 610); superconducting solenoid with compensating solenoids; data until 3 November 1986.
